u: SANE-based scan utility for HPLIP supported all-in-one/mfp devices.
<dl><dt>To specify a device-URI:</dt><dd>-d<device-uri> or --device=<device-uri></dd><dt>To specify a CUPS printer:</dt><dd>-p<printer> or --printer=<printer></dd></dl>

<dl><dt>Set the logging level:</dt><dd>-l<level> or --logging=<level> <level>: none, info*, error, warn, debug (*default)</dd><dt>Run in debug mode:</dt><dd>-g (same as option: -ldebug)</dd><dt>This help information:</dt><dd>-h or --help</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>Scan destinations:</dt><dd>-s<dest_list> or --dest=<dest_list> where <dest_list> is a comma separated list containing one or more of: 'file' , 'viewer', 'editor', 'pdf', or 'print'. Use only commas between values, no spaces.</dd><dt>Scan mode:</dt><dd>-m<mode> or --mode=<mode>. Where <mode> is 'gray'*, 'color' or 'lineart'.</dd><dt>Scanning resolution:</dt><dd>-r<resolution_in_dpi> or --res=<resolution_in_dpi> or --resolution=<resolution_in_dpi> where 300 is default.</dd><dt>Image resize:</dt><dd>--resize=<scale_in_%> (min=1%, max=400%, default=100%)</dd><dt>Color Dropout Red :</dt><dd>-color_dropout_red_value=<color_dropout_red_value> or --color_dropout_red_value=<color_dropout_red_value></dd><dt>Color Dropout Green :</dt><dd>-color_dropout_green_value=<color_dropout_green_value> or --color_dropout_green_value=<color_dropout_green_value></dd><dt>Color Dropout Blue :</dt><dd>-color_dropout_blue_value=<color_dropout_blue_value> or --color_dropout_blue_value=<color_dropout_blue_value></dd><dt>Color Dropout Range :</dt><dd>-color_range=<color_range> or --color_range=<color_range></dd><dt>Image contrast:</dt><dd>-c=<contrast> or --contrast=<contrast> The contrast range varies from device to device.</dd><dt>Image brightness:</dt><dd>-b=<brightness> or --brightness=<brightness> The brightness range varies from device to device.</dd><dt>ADF mode:</dt><dd>--adf (Note, only PDF output is supported when using the ADF) --duplex or --dup for duplex scanning using ADF.</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>Specify the units for area/box measurements:</dt><dd>-t<units> or --units=<units> where <units> is 'mm'*, 'cm', 'in', 'px', or 'pt' ('mm' is default).</dd><dt>Scan area:</dt><dd>-a<tlx>,<tly>,<brx>,<bry> or --area=<tlx>,<tly>,<brx>,<bry> Coordinates are relative to the upper left corner of the scan area. Units for tlx, tly, brx, and bry are specified by -t/--units (default is 'mm'). Use only commas between values, no spaces.</dd><dt>Scan box:</dt><dd>--box=<tlx>,<tly>,<width>,<height> tlx and tly coordinates are relative to the upper left corner of the scan area. Units for tlx, tly, width, and height are specified by -t/--units (default is 'mm'). Use only commas between values, no spaces.</dd><dt>Top left x of the scan area:</dt><dd>--tlx=<tlx> Coordinates are relative to the upper left corner of the scan area. Units are specified by -t/--units (default is 'mm').</dd><dt>Top left y of the scan area:</dt><dd>--tly=<tly> Coordinates are relative to the upper left corner of the scan area. Units are specified by -t/--units (default is 'mm').</dd><dt>Bottom right x of the scan area:</dt><dd>--brx=<brx> Coordinates are relative to the upper left corner of the scan area. Units are specified by -t/--units (default is 'mm').</dd><dt>Bottom right y of the scan area:</dt><dd>--bry=<bry> Coordinates are relative to the upper left corner of the scan area. Units are specified by -t/--units (default is 'mm').</dd><dt>Specify the scan area based on a paper size:</dt><dd>--size=<paper size name> where <paper size name> is one of: 3x5, 4x6, 5x7, a2_env, a3, a4, a5, a6, b4, b5, c6_env, dl_env, exec, flsa, higaki, japan_env_3, japan_env_4, legal, letter, no_10_env, oufufu-hagaki, photo, super_b</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>From: address for 'email' dest:</dt><dd>--email-from=<email_from_address> (required for 'email' dest.)</dd><dt>To: address for 'email' dest:</dt><dd>--email-to=<email__to_address> (required for 'email' dest.)</dd><dt>Email subject for 'email' dest:</dt><dd>--email-subject="<subject>" or --subject="<subject>" Use double quotes (") around the subject if it contains space characters.</dd><dt>Note or message for the 'email' dest:</dt><dd>--email-msg="<msg>" or --email-note="<note>" Use double quotes (") around the note/message if it contains space characters.</dd></dl>
<dl><dt>Printer queue/printer dest:</dt><dd>--dp=<printer_name> or --dest-printer=<printer_name></dd><dt>Printer device-URI dest:</dt><dd>--dd=<device-uri> or --dest-device=<device-uri></dd></dl>
<dl><dt>Set the scanner compression mode:</dt><dd>-x<mode> or --compression=<mode>, <mode>='raw', 'none' or 'jpeg' ('jpeg' is default) ('raw' and 'none' are equivalent)</dd></dl>
HPLIP (HP Linux Imaging and Printing) is an HP developed solution for printing, scanning, and faxing with HP inkjet and laser based printers in Linux.
The HPLIP Launchpad.net site https://launchpad.net/hplip is available to get help, report bugs, make suggestions, discuss the HPLIP project or otherwise contact the HPLIP Team.
